Elson confirmed his recent good form by finishing 10th, and here we would like to record our appreciation of the good nature and splendid sportsmanship of one of our second-claim members, W.
The team handicap was won by S.W.C., with Woodford Green A.C. second. Our "B" team (Jones, Elson, McMullen, Snell) took third prizes.
Our team won the scratch team race and consisted of Green, Fletcher, Scamell and Frank Elson. The Club Junior Walk was won by Elson, with E.
